findings.finding: [native] The checked Serilog row is painted with the selection band (list.inactiveSelectionBackground under the scrim) but the details pane beside it reads "Select a package to see its details." and the band shows no row action, whereas the artboard's current row (Newtonsoft.Json) carries the band, its uninstall action and its details; in a multi-select list only the current row may take the band, so band and details contradict each other. | [states] The checked Serilog row has the inactive-selection band, the colour DS-COLOR-2 gives the current row of a multi-select list. The details pane beside it still shows "Select a package to see its details." instead of that row's details, as the artboard's package-details-panel draws for its current row. Either the band is painted for a row that is only in the bulk set, or the current row's details are missing.
findings.evidence: outside `.nuiget-dialog`; the page beneath is judged against a stand-in artboard (design-advisor ruling UX-P3.5 DO 9, DECISIONS 2026-11-07); the band of a bulk-checked row is UX-P2.1c's form and the Installed states' judge's, not this item's

findings.finding: [native] The open confirm dialog shows no focus ring on any control: Cancel (where the dialog opens) keeps its plain 1 px secondary border and Uninstall its plain fill, unlike a workbench dialog whose focused button carries the 1 px focusBorder ring at offset +2. | [states] No control in the open confirm dialog shows a focus ring. The dialog's Cancel button, which §7 says receives focus when the dialog opens, has no 1 px focusBorder outline at offset +2. In the main panel DS-FOCUS-3 draws rings after a click as well, so focus cannot be seen anywhere in the modal.
findings.evidence: a dialog opened by a pointer click under Modern UI focuses Cancel programmatically without `:focus-visible`: no ring is the DS-FOCUS-3 premise P-3 (DECISIONS 2026-11-07, follow-up 2 case ii); run 42402701440 `DS-FOCUS-1@main-installed-bulk-dialog/controls: … outline 3 none` reads the same; the ring's form is read on the keyboard-opened bulk dialog of the `[keys]` walk

findings.finding: [native] The dialog's primary button label 'Install in 0 projects' is not in Title Case ('projects' is lowercase), against the button-label casing of the workbench exemplars ('Add Pattern', 'Open Repository'). | [states] The dialog's primary button reads "Install in 0 projects" with "projects" in lower case; DS-COPY-1 requires Title Case on button labels ("Install in 0 Projects"), the same casing the design system uses for this command ("Install in Projects...").

refuted.finding: The two header actions under the scrim draw different codicons from the approved artboard: the capture shows a gear and a two-arrow sync glyph, while the artboard draws a sun-like glyph and a single-arrow refresh at the same positions.
refuted.reason: The capture draws a gear and a two-arrow glyph, which match the icon plan's settings-gear and sync codicons (docs/design/icons.json), so DS-ICON-1 holds for the capture. Only the borrowed main-installed-details artboard draws them differently, and the spec names just the 'source-settings' and 'refresh-button' rects, not their glyphs. The box also had to be clamped at the 1200 px edge.
